value: A 800G twin-port optical module, opened up: its footprint drawn to its published size, its layers pulled apart vertically, its parts representative. It carries two 400G links: one shared eight-lane DSP serves a representative photonics chip, with eight 100G transmit channels grouped on one side and eight receive channels on the other.
